decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to control the game through card advantage and resource management. By using a combination of card draw spells, removal spells, and powerful creatures like Thor, God of Thunder, the deck aims to out-value and outlast the opponent in a 1 vs 1 situation. By effectively managing and utilizing resources like mana and card advantage, the deck can maintain board control and ultimately come out on top in the late game.

The main concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures like Leatherhead, Swamp Stalker and Pawpatch Recruit, supported by combat tricks and removal spells such as Meltstrider's Resolve, Seam Rip, and Erode. The deck also utilizes mana acceleration from Llanowar Elves and Abandoned Air Temple to quickly deploy threats like Brightglass Gearhulk and Ouroboroid. The inclusion of Surrak, Elusive Hunter and Jennifer Walters provides additional utility and resilience. The deck aims to maintain a strong board presence and apply constant pressure to the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of card draw, removal, and counterspells to control the game and outvalue the opponent. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the player aims to stall the game until they can establish a dominant position and win through powerful spells and creatures like Thor, God of Thunder and Gran-Gran. The key strategy revolves around maintaining card advantage, controlling the board, and finding the right timing to close out the game with explosive plays.

This deck aims to control the battlefield through a combination of artifact production and removal spells. Using cards like Legion Extruder and Tezzeret, Cruel Captain to generate artifacts, the deck can then use cards like Candy Trail and Weapons Manufacturing to create powerful effects. By utilizing a mix of creature removal, artifact creation, and card draw, the deck seeks to outvalue and outlast opponents, ultimately gaining control of the game. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the color requirements of the spells, ensuring consistent performance in 1 vs 1 matchups.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying low-cost creatures and aggressively attacking the opponent's life total. By utilizing cards like Aang, Swift Savior and Voice of Victory, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of quick creatures. The inclusion of control elements like Aven Interrupter and Spell Snare allows the deck to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining its aggressive stance. Additionally, cards like High Noon and Avatar's Wrath provide extra damage and removal options to help secure victory. The deck's mana base is designed to efficiently support its game plan while ensuring consistent performance.

The main idea of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly create pressure on the opponent by playing low-cost spells and creatures, utilizing tempo and card advantage to maintain control of the game. With a focus on cheap spells and recurring damage, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of direct damage, card draw, and efficient creatures. By using a combination of burn spells, evasive creatures, and disruption, this deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot, while steadily increasing its own resources and board presence.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost spells and creatures to pressure the opponent quickly, while also controlling the board with bounce effects and counterspells. It aims to win through aggressive play and card advantage with cards like Eddymurk Crab, Slickshot Show-Off, and Stormchaser's Talent. The deck also includes versatile cards like Boomerang Basics and Multiversal Passage for additional utility. By combining efficient threats with disruptive spells, this UR Aggro deck can overwhelm opponents and secure victory in a fast-paced match.

This deck focuses on aggressively playing spells and creatures to deal damage to the opponent quickly. It utilizes cheap instants and sorceries to trigger cards like Slickshot Show-Off and Stormchaser's Talent, while also including creatures like Eddymurk Crab and Colorstorm Stallion to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Burst Lightning and Spell Pierce, while also using evasion with cards like Secret Identity and Vibrant Outburst to push damage through. The flexibility of the deck allows for adaptability in different matchups.

The deck focuses on quickly and efficiently building up a board presence with a combination of low-cost creatures and control spells. By using cards like Avatar's Wrath and Spell Snare to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also utilizing cards like Voice of Victory and Aang, Swift Savior to apply pressure, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory. The mana base is structured to ensure consistency and allow for easy access to all necessary colors of mana for casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient combat tricks, utilizing the synergy between Selesnya creatures and powerful land cards. The deck focuses on generating early pressure with low-cost creatures like Llanowar Elves and Pawpatch Recruit, supported by cards like Practiced Offense and Seam Rip to push damage through. The inclusion of high-impact creatures like Leatherhead, Swamp Stalker and Brightglass Gearhulk further solidifies the deck's aggressive game plan, aiming to maintain strong board presence and close out the game quickly.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with Azorius aggro creatures and control spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The key idea is to quickly establish a board presence with efficient creatures like Voice of Victory and Aang, Swift Savior, while using spells like Erode and Spell Snare to deal with threats. By combining aggression with disruption, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. Mana fixing is also important with a mix of lands to ensure consistent access to the cards needed to execute the game plan effectively.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the aggressive nature of Selesnya creatures and spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By combining efficient green mana acceleration with powerful white creatures like Brightglass Gearhulk and Surrak, Elusive Hunter, the deck aims to put intense pressure on the opponent from the beginning. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Practiced Offense and Leatherhead, Swamp Stalker allows for consistent damage output while maintaining a high level of threat on the board. This deck focuses on maintaining a steady stream of creatures and spells to assert dominance and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient spells. The deck focuses on utilizing cheap spells and abilities to control the board while also applying pressure with fast creatures like Eddymurk Crab and Slickshot Show-Off. The goal is to maintain a tempo advantage by bouncing opposing threats with cards like Boomerang Basics and Burst Lightning, while also drawing cards and maintaining card advantage with Opt and Sleight of Hand. The deck aims to end the game swiftly by utilizing a mix of direct damage and evasive creatures.

The focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with key combo pieces, then use reanimation spells to bring them back onto the battlefield for a powerful and unpredictable assault on the opponent. The deck utilizes a mix of spells to manipulate the graveyard, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and protect its own key pieces. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures and game-changing spells, taking advantage of the synergy between the different cards in the deck to achieve victory.

The main concept of this deck is to control the pace of the game by using a combination of spell removal, card draw, and powerful creatures. The deck focuses on reducing the opponent's resources while building up your own card advantage through cards like Accumulate Wisdom and Tablet of Discovery. Cards like Combustion Technique and Firebending Lesson provide removal options, while powerful creatures like Gran-Gran and Thor, God of Thunder can help finish off the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the game until you can secure a win.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of card draw, removal spells, and powerful creatures like North Wind Avatar. The goal is to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent with cards like Tablet of Discovery and Stock Up. By utilizing a mix of different lands and a variety of spells, the deck aims to adapt to different situations and outlast the opponent through attrition. The deck also includes cards like Consult the Star Charts and Jeskai Revelation to generate card advantage and ensure a steady stream of resources throughout the game.
